meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'делать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'make, cause'.

examples.text: Что, я зря пришла? Я надела костюм зайки!

meanings.note: Formed with a diminutive/expressive Slavic suffix adding warmth or small scale. Common masculine noun meaning 'hint' in everyday Russian.

examples.trans: This is our town. We have nobody to fear here.

Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ъявить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to announce, declare', paired with 'объявлять'.

examples.trans: The director announced the start of the meeting.

examples.text: Перед тем, как я объявлю победителя, внимание!
examples.trans: Before I announce the winner, your attention!

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)
meanings.note: Case forms. Core Russian pron meaning 'he; it' in everyday speech.

Used as an exclamation of approval. Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'лично'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Отлично, Ваня! Вот это твой образ!
examples.trans: Perfect, Vanya! That right there is your look!

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'нимать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'lift up! / raise!'.

examples.text: Поднимай меня вон туда, на третий этаж!
examples.trans: Lift me up over there, to the third floor!

examples.text: Надо всё сделать и поднимать вовремя.
examples.trans: We need to do everything and lift up! on time.

meanings.note: Подожди! = wait!. Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to wait (a while)', paired with 'ждать'.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'нять'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to understand', paired with 'понимать'.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.en: a bit earlier, a little earlier
meanings.note: Colloquial comparative of рано. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'раньше').

meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'then, later, afterwards' in everyday speech.
